publicationAttribution.creators: Avery J. C. Noonan, Lucas Moriniere, Edwin O. Rivera-López, Krish Patel, Melina Pena, et al.
publicationAttribution.title: Phylogeny-agnostic strain-level prediction of phage–host interactions from genomes using machine learning
publicationAttribution.role: Publication explaining source experimental banks; no article text or figures copied and no GenoPHI predictor run for this website.

transformations: The demo selects two evaluated banks, preserves raw saved score values and binary observed labels, joins exact identifiers to compact metadata, and omits 60 unscored/unobserved BASEL cells without treating them as negatives. Complete consumed-source paths and SHA-256 hashes are in provenance.json.
